source: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program GeoJSON summary feed (M2.5+, global, rolling 24h window)
license: US government public domain (usgs.gov/information-policies-and-notices/copyrights-and-credits) — no key, no rate limit documented, commercial-lawful with attribution

field_map.id: USGS's own stable event id (e.g. us6000taui) — used as the archive dedup key
field_map.updated: last-revised time, ms epoch UTC — magnitude/location can change during review; a later archive row with a newer `updated` supersedes an earlier one for the same id
field_map.tsunami: USGS tsunami-advisory flag for this event
field_map.type: USGS event type — kept as-reported, never filtered (includes non-earthquake types like quarry blast)
field_map.rt: as-seen date (UTC day WE fetched it)

confidence_model: RAW overlay — USGS-reported values carried verbatim, including unreviewed 'automatic' status and events USGS later marks 'deleted' (retracted, not silently dropped from the archive). No predictive claim; a future hazard-exposure SIGNAL (insurer/utility/supply-chain) is separate, unattempted gate-1/gate-2 work.
cadence: 15-min poll; M2.5+ global feed, upstream refreshes ~every 5 min
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
